gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-sarpanch: Geometric and crisp. Conthrax is built for big, bold statements, while Sarpanch stays approachable, with a clearly open e and a compact gap up to its ascenders.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-schibsted-grotesk: Conthrax draws every tail and terminal as thick as its stems, wide and stencil-sharp. Schibsted Grotesk loosens things with open-looking e and a shapes and terminals that never close in.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-sen: Conthrax runs wide in the lowercase a, with bodies so large the capitals barely stand above them. And Sen follows with a constant line tracing each lowercase letter, curves ending before they turn inward.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-sintony: Clean and contemporary. Conthrax keeps strokes contrast-free from stem to terminal, and Sintony answers with a chunky midzone and smooth curves that never clog.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-sofia-sans: Cut acrylic, basically. Conthrax is best at wide geometric display lines, whereas Sofia Sans does its best work with rounded, monoline letters and a clearly open side.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-sono: Approachable and professional, Sono leaves each lowercase a with its mouth ajar. Conthrax handles the geometric heavy lifting in glyphs cut from equal-width strips, while Sono spaces its letters generously.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-stack-sans-headli: Conthrax's lowercase is so large that capitals barely stand taller, with a wide-mouthed a. And Stack Sans Headline suits big, short lines, then steps back with a monoline skeleton and wide gaps that keep tiny sizes crisp.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-stack-sans-notch: Conthrax has a wide-mouthed a and lowercase so large it nearly matches the capitals. Stack Sans Notch follows with open curves you can see into and rod-stock strokes, so a long stretch of text reads smoothly.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-stack-sans-text: Conthrax gives its lowercase a wide mouth and bodies that crowd up toward the capitals. Stack Sans Text then carries a longer stretch with a marker-like line and well-spaced curve endings, so reading feels easygoing.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-ubuntu-sans: Bent copper pipe, in type form. Conthrax keeps a wide a and geometric precision, and Ubuntu Sans brings washer-sized lowercase eyes, which makes this pair feel both sturdy and modern.
